bundle_measurements.caveat: BS-01 as specified is NOT EXECUTABLE, proven empirically: the current vendor-portal@dev HEAD requires framework >=2.3.0 (uses `hotkey` and IBladeToolbar.shortcut). Builds against 2.1.0 and 2.2.0 fail at TYPE level (39 errors) AND, with the type gate stubbed, at BUNDLE level (Rollup: 'hotkey' is not exported by framework.js). Verified `hotkey` present in framework.js in 2.3.0 only. Recommend replacing BS-01 with the barrel-level metric above.
